12 public sealed record AgentDescriptorDto(
13−    string Agent, bool Available, string DisplayName);
13+    string Agent,

Three nullable strings with no enum behind Unavailability means every client re-invents the branch. Make it a typed discriminator so the remedy can be rendered without string comparison.
